# Workable

Workable is an all-in-one HR software platform that streamlines hiring, employee data management, time tracking, and payroll.

Category: Recruiting & HR. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/workable/.

## Actions

- **Get Candidates** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all candidates across jobs.
- **Create Department**: Create a department in your account.
- **Delete Department**: Delete a department.
- **Enable Member**: Restore a deactivated member.
- **Get Account**: Return the specified account.
- **Get Accounts**: Retrieve a collection of all accounts you have access to.
- **Get Background Check Packages**: Retrieve a list of available background check packages from a specified provider.
- **Get Background Check Providers**: Retrieve a list of available background check providers.
- **Get Events**: Retrieve a collection of events scheduled in the account.
- **Get Jobs**: Retrieve a list of jobs from your workable account.
- **Get Legal Entities**: Retrieve a collection of your account legal entities.
- **Get Members**: Retrieve a list of your workable account members.
- **Get recruiters**: Retrieve external recruiters.
- **Get Requisitions**: Retrieve a collection of requisitions in the account.
- **Get Stages**: Retrieve a collection of your recruitment pipeline stages.
- **Get Subscriptions**: List all active subscriptions.
- **Invite Member**: Invite a member to your workable account.
- **Merge Department**: Merge a department into another.
- **Post Background Check**: Inject background check results directly into the candidate's timeline.
- **Update Department**: Update an existing department in your account.
- **Update Member**: Update a member's details.
